name: Biurrun-Olcoz (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the arms of Biurrun-Olcoz (a cross patty above a tree on a green mount on red, timbred with a helmet).
history: Municipal flag of Biurrun-Olcoz; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
